sw.L: Wakaondoka saa ile ile, wakarudi Yerusalemu, wakawakuta wale kumi na mmoja wamekusanyika pamoja na wale waliokuwa pamoja nao, \v 34 nao walikuwa wakisema, "Bwana amefufuliwa kweli, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} amemtokea Simoni!"
sw.B: Bila kukawia waliondoka, wakarudi Yerusalemu. Wakawakuta wale Kumi na Mmoja wamekusanyika pamoja na wenzao, \v 34 ambao walikuwa wakisema, "Kweli Bwana amefufuliwa, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} amemtokea Simoni!"
sw.R: Mara moja waliondoka, wakarudi Yerusalemu. Huko wakawakuta mitume kumi na mmoja na wengine waliokuwa pamoja nao. \v 34 Hao walikuwa wakisema, "Kweli Bwana amefufuka kutoka kwa wafu! Amemtokea Simoni!"

vi.L: Ngay giờ ấy họ đứng dậy trở về Giê-ru-sa-lem, và thấy [nhóm] Mười Một và những người ở với họ đang nhóm họp, \v 34 nói rằng: "Chúa thật đã được làm cho sống lại, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hiện ra cho Si-môn!"
vi.B: Ngay lúc ấy, họ đứng dậy trở về Giê-ru-sa-lem. Họ thấy nhóm Mười Một đang nhóm họp cùng với những người khác, \v 34 và những người ấy nói: "Chúa đã thật sự được làm cho sống lại, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hiện ra cho Si-môn!"
vi.R: Họ liền đứng dậy và trở về Giê-ru-sa-lem. Ở đó họ gặp mười một sứ đồ và những người khác đang ở với các sứ đồ. \v 34 Những người ấy nói: "Chúa đã sống lại thật rồi! Ngài đã hiện ra cho Si-môn!"

ko.L: 그리고 그들은 바로 그 시각에 일어나 예루살렘으로 돌아갔다. 그리고 열한 [제자]와 그들과 함께 있는 사람들이 모여 있는 것을 보았다. \v 34 그들이 말하고 있었다. "주님께서 정말 살아나셨고, 시몬에게 나타나셨다!"
ko.B: 그들은 곧바로 일어나 예루살렘으로 돌아갔다. 가 보니 열한 제자와 그 일행이 모여 있었다. \v 34 그들이 말했다. "주님께서 정말로 살아나셔서 시몬에게 나타나셨다!"
ko.R: 그들은 바로 일어나서 예루살렘으로 돌아갔다. 거기에는 열한 제자와 그들과 함께 있던 사람들이 모여 있었다. \v 34 그들이 말하고 있었다. "주님께서 정말 죽음에서 살아나셨다! 시몬에게 나타나셨다!"

pt.L: E, levantando-se naquela mesma hora, voltaram para Jerusalém e encontraram reunidos os Onze e os que estavam com eles, \v 34 que diziam: "O Senhor realmente foi ressuscitado e apareceu a Simão!"
pt.B: Sem demora, eles se levantaram e voltaram para Jerusalém. Encontraram os Onze reunidos com os companheiros deles, \v 34 que diziam: "O Senhor foi ressuscitado de verdade e apareceu a Simão!"
pt.R: Na mesma hora, eles se levantaram e voltaram para Jerusalém. Lá encontraram os onze apóstolos e os outros que estavam com eles. \v 34 Eles estavam dizendo: "O Senhor ressuscitou mesmo! Ele apareceu a Simão!"

am.L: በዚያችም ሰዓት ተነሥተው ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተመለሱ፤ አሥራ አንዱንና ከእነርሱ ጋር ያሉትንም ተሰብስበው አገኙአቸው፤ \v 34 እነርሱም፦ «ጌታ በእውነት ተነሥቷል፤ ለስምዖንም ታይቷል!» ይሉ ነበር።
am.B: ሳይዘገዩ ተነሥተው ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተመለሱ። አሥራ አንዱንና አብረዋቸው የነበሩትን ተሰብስበው አገኙአቸው፤ \v 34 እነርሱም፦ «ጌታ በእውነት ተነሥቷል፤ ለስምዖንም ተገልጧል!» ይሉ ነበር።
am.R: ወዲያውኑ ተነሥተው ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተመለሱ። በዚያም አሥራ አንዱን ሐዋርያትና ከእነርሱ ጋር የነበሩትን ሌሎች ሰዎች አገኙ። \v 34 እነርሱም፦ «ጌታ በእርግጥ ከሞት ተነሥቷል! ለስምዖንም ታይቷል!» ይሉ ነበር።

decisions.choice: that same hour: at once
decisions.reason: "Hour" is often used for a moment or a short time. Though it was evening (24:29), they set out at once for Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: saying: the eleven and their companions are the ones speaking
alternatives: the two from Emmaus are speaking
decisions.reason: The word "saying" agrees with "the eleven and those with them". Before the two can tell their news, the others greet them with theirs.

decisions.choice: Simon: Simon Peter
decisions.reason: Luke calls Peter Simon (5:3-10; 22:31). His meeting with the risen Lord is not told, but Paul names Cephas, which is Peter, as the first of the apostles to see him (1 Corinthians 15:5).

decisions.choice: has appeared: has been seen
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for the appearances of the risen Jesus (Acts 13:31; 1 Corinthians 15:5-8). It means a real meeting.

decisions.choice: has really been raised: God has raised him
decisions.reason: The verb is passive, as in 24:6. "Really" answers the doubt of the morning (24:11).

decisions.choice: Without delay (B); Right away (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the time phrase.

decisions.choice: has risen from death
decisions.reason: Readable uses the active verb, which children understand more easily; Jesus also speaks of himself as rising (24:7, 46).

decisions.choice: que decían (L, B); Estos decían (R)
decisions.reason: The ones speaking are the eleven and their companions, not the two travellers (meaning decision m2). A Spanish gerund would attach to the subject of the sentence, the two, so every level uses a clause that points to the eleven.

decisions.choice: nao walikuwa wakisema (L); ambao walikuwa wakisema (B); Hao walikuwa wakisema (R)
decisions.reason: The ones speaking are the eleven and their companions, not the two travellers (meaning decision m2). A bare "wakisema" would be read with the subject of the sentence, the two, so every level points back to the eleven.

decisions.choice: "đã được làm cho sống lại" (L, B); "đã sống lại" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the passive, God's act (meaning decision), as in 24:6; Readable uses the plain active, as the English Readable does. The speakers are the Eleven and their companions (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "주님" for the risen Lord; "살아나셨다" for the passive "has been raised", as in 24:6
decisions.reason: "주님" is how the Korean John and Mark 16:20 name the risen Jesus; the passive means God raised him (meaning decision), which Korean says with the usual verb.

source.text: καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐξηγοῦντο τὰ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ καὶ ὡς ἐγνώσθη αὐτοῖς ἐν τῇ κλάσει τοῦ ἄρτου.

records.literal_gloss: And they were relating the things on the road and how he was made known to them in the breaking of the bread.

en.L: And they told the things [that happened] on the road, and how {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was made known to them in the breaking of the bread.
en.B: The two then told their own story: what took place on the road, and how {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} became known to them in the breaking of the bread.
en.R: Then the two followers told what had happened to them on the road. They told how they knew it was Jesus when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} broke the bread.

es.L: Y ellos relataban lo [sucedido] en el camino, y cómo {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les fue dado a conocer en el partimiento del pan.
es.B: Entonces los dos contaron lo que les había pasado en el camino, y cómo {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se les había dado a conocer al partir el pan.
es.R: Entonces los dos discípulos contaron lo que les había pasado en el camino. Contaron cómo se dieron cuenta de que era Jesús cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} partió el pan.

fr.L: Et eux racontaient ce qui [s’était passé] sur le chemin, et comment {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’était fait reconnaître d’eux à la fraction du pain.
fr.B: Les deux racontèrent à leur tour ce qui s’était passé en chemin, et comment {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’était fait reconnaître d’eux au moment de rompre le pain.
fr.R: Alors les deux disciples ont raconté ce qui leur était arrivé sur la route. Ils ont raconté comment ils avaient reconnu Jésus quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait rompu le pain.

sw.L: Nao wakaeleza mambo [yaliyotokea] njiani, na jinsi alivyojulikana kwao katika kuumega mkate.
sw.B: Kisha wale wawili wakaeleza yaliyowapata njiani, na jinsi alivyotambulika kwao alipoumega mkate.
sw.R: Kisha wale wanafunzi wawili wakaeleza yaliyowapata njiani. Wakasema jinsi walivyojua kwamba ni Yesu alipoumega mkate.

vi.L: Còn hai người kia thì thuật lại những việc [đã xảy ra] trên đường, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã được họ nhận biết thế nào trong lúc bẻ bánh.
vi.B: Rồi hai người kể lại những việc đã xảy ra trên đường đi, và họ đã nhận ra {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thế nào khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bẻ bánh.
vi.R: Rồi hai người ấy kể lại những gì đã xảy ra cho họ trên đường. Họ kể rằng họ đã nhận ra Đức Giê-xu khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bẻ bánh.

ko.L: 그러자 그들도 길에서 있었던 일들과, 빵을 떼실 때에 그분이 자기들에게 알려지신 일을 이야기했다.
ko.B: 그러자 두 사람도 길에서 있었던 일과, 예수께서 빵을 떼실 때에 자기들이 그분을 알아보게 된 일을 이야기했다.
ko.R: 두 사람도 길에서 있었던 일을 이야기했다. 그리고 예수께서 빵을 떼실 때에 그분이 예수이신 것을 알아보았다고 말했다.

pt.L: E eles contavam as coisas [acontecidas] no caminho e como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes foi dado a conhecer no partir do pão.
pt.B: Os dois, então, contaram a sua parte: o que tinha acontecido no caminho e como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se deu a conhecer a eles no partir do pão.
pt.R: Então os dois seguidores contaram o que tinha acontecido com eles no caminho. Contaram como perceberam que era Jesus quando {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} partiu o pão.

am.L: እነርሱም በመንገድ ላይ [የሆነውን] ነገር፣ ዳቦውንም በመቁረስ እንዴት እንደ ታወቀላቸው ተረኩ።
am.B: ሁለቱም ደግሞ በመንገድ ላይ የሆነውን፣ ዳቦውንም በቆረሰበት ጊዜ እንዴት እንደ ታወቀላቸው ተረኩላቸው።
am.R: ከዚያም ሁለቱ ደቀ መዛሙርት በመንገድ ላይ የሆነባቸውን ነገሩ። ዳቦውን በቆረሰ ጊዜ ኢየሱስ መሆኑን እንዴት እንዳወቁም ነገሩ።

decisions.choice: they: the two, now telling their side
decisions.reason: The pronoun is emphatic: after the others have told about Simon, the two tell what happened to them.

decisions.choice: the breaking of the bread: the meal he shared with them
decisions.reason: Breaking the bread began a Jewish meal. Luke uses the same phrase for the shared meals of the first believers (Acts 2:42), where Jesus' followers met him again in the meal.

decisions.choice: was made known: the passive
decisions.reason: The two did not figure it out; it was shown to them (24:31).

decisions.choice: the two (B); the two followers (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say which group is speaking.

decisions.choice: "자기들이 그분을 알아보게 된 일" (B), "알아보았다" (R) for the passive "he was made known"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the passive; Balanced and Readable say it from the two men's side, which is natural Korean.

source.text: Ταῦτα δὲ αὐτῶν λαλούντων αὐτὸς ἔστη ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν.

records.literal_gloss: These things now them speaking, he himself stood in [the] midst of them.

en.L: And while they were saying these things, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} stood in [the] middle of them.
en.B: As they were talking about all this, Jesus {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} was standing among them.
en.R: While they were talking about this, Jesus {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} suddenly stood among them.

es.L: Y mientras ellos decían estas cosas, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} mismo se puso en medio de ellos.
es.B: Mientras hablaban de todo esto, Jesús mismo estaba allí, en medio de ellos.
es.R: Mientras hablaban de esto, de repente Jesús mismo se puso en medio de ellos.

fr.L: Et tandis qu’ils disaient ces choses, {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} se tint au milieu d’eux.
fr.B: Ils parlaient encore de tout cela quand Jésus {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} se tint là, au milieu d’eux.
fr.R: Pendant qu’ils parlaient de tout cela, Jésus {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} s’est soudain trouvé debout au milieu d’eux.

sw.L: Nao walipokuwa wakisema hayo, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} akasimama katikati yao.
sw.B: Walipokuwa wakiyazungumza hayo, Yesu {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} alikuwa amesimama katikati yao.
sw.R: Walipokuwa wakizungumza hayo, ghafla Yesu {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} alisimama katikati yao.

vi.L: Đang khi họ nói những điều này, chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đứng giữa họ.
vi.B: Họ còn đang nói chuyện thì chính Đức Giê-xu đứng giữa họ.
vi.R: Trong khi họ đang nói chuyện về điều ấy, bỗng nhiên chính Đức Giê-xu đứng giữa họ.

ko.L: 그들이 이런 이야기를 하고 있을 때에, 그분이 친히 그들 가운데 서셨다.
ko.B: 그들이 이런 이야기를 하고 있을 때, 예수께서 몸소 그들 가운데 서셨다.
ko.R: 그들이 이 이야기를 하고 있을 때, 갑자기 예수께서 직접 그들 가운데 서셨다.

pt.L: E, enquanto eles falavam essas coisas, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} mesmo se pôs de pé no meio deles.
pt.B: Enquanto falavam sobre tudo isso, o próprio Jesus apareceu de pé no meio deles.
pt.R: Enquanto eles conversavam sobre isso, de repente o próprio Jesus estava ali no meio deles.

am.L: ይህንም ሲናገሩ እርሱ ራሱ በመካከላቸው ቆመ።
am.B: ስለዚህ ነገር እየተነጋገሩ ሳሉ ኢየሱስ ራሱ በመካከላቸው ቆሞ ነበር።
am.R: ስለዚህ ነገር እየተነጋገሩ ሳሉ ኢየሱስ ራሱ ድንገት በመካከላቸው ቆመ።

decisions.choice: the sentence ends with "among them", as in the SBLGNT
alternatives: the sentence goes on, "and he says to them, Peace to you", the reading of most manuscripts
decisions.reason: Most manuscripts, the early papyrus P75 among them, add "and he says to them, Peace to you". Codex Bezae and some Old Latin manuscripts lack the words, and the SBLGNT follows them here. The same words are found in John 20:19, and some think they came from there. Codex Bezae and some Old Latin manuscripts, known as Western witnesses, usually have a longer text than other manuscripts, but near the end of Luke they have a shorter text in several places. Where witnesses that tend to add leave something out, the shorter reading may be the original. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: he himself stood among them: Jesus appears without coming through a door
decisions.reason: Luke does not say how he came; he had vanished at Emmaus in the same way (24:31). "Himself" stresses that it was Jesus in person.

decisions.choice: suddenly
decisions.reason: Readable brings out the surprise of his coming, which 24:37 shows.

source.text: πτοηθέντες δὲ καὶ ἔμφοβοι γενόμενοι ἐδόκουν πνεῦμα θεωρεῖν.

records.literal_gloss: Having been startled however and terrified having become they were thinking a spirit to see.

en.L: But being startled and becoming terrified, they thought they were seeing a spirit.
en.B: But they were alarmed and filled with fear, for they thought they were looking at a spirit.
en.R: They were shocked and very much afraid. They thought a ghost was standing there.

es.L: Pero, espantados y llenándose de terror, pensaban que veían un espíritu.
es.B: Pero ellos se alarmaron y se llenaron de miedo, porque pensaban que estaban viendo un espíritu.
es.R: Ellos se asustaron mucho y tuvieron miedo. Pensaban que estaban viendo un fantasma.

fr.L: Mais, effrayés et devenus pleins de crainte, ils pensaient voir un esprit.
fr.B: Mais ils furent saisis d’effroi et de crainte, car ils croyaient voir un esprit.
fr.R: Ils ont eu un choc et ils ont eu très peur. Ils pensaient qu’ils voyaient un fantôme.

sw.L: Lakini wakashtuka na kujawa na hofu, wakadhani wanaona roho.
sw.B: Lakini walishtuka na kujawa na hofu, kwa sababu walidhani wanaona roho.
sw.R: Walishtuka na kuogopa sana. Walidhani wanaona mzuka.

vi.L: Nhưng họ hoảng hốt và kinh sợ, tưởng mình đang thấy một linh hồn.
vi.B: Nhưng họ hốt hoảng và kinh sợ, vì tưởng mình đang thấy một linh hồn.
vi.R: Họ giật mình và rất sợ hãi. Họ tưởng mình đang thấy ma.

ko.L: 그러나 그들은 놀라고 두려워하여, 영을 보고 있다고 생각했다.
ko.B: 그러나 그들은 놀라고 무서워서, 영을 보고 있는 줄로 생각했다.
ko.R: 그들은 깜짝 놀라고 몹시 무서웠다. 유령이 나타났다고 생각했다.

pt.L: Mas, assustados e cheios de medo, pensavam estar vendo um espírito.
pt.B: Mas eles ficaram alarmados e cheios de medo, pois pensavam que estavam vendo um espírito.
pt.R: Eles levaram um susto e ficaram com muito medo. Pensaram que estavam vendo um fantasma.

am.L: እነርሱ ግን ደንግጠውና ፈርተው መንፈስ የሚያዩ መሰላቸው።
am.B: እነርሱ ግን ደነገጡ፤ በፍርሀትም ተሞሉ፤ መንፈስ የሚያዩ መስሏቸው ነበርና።
am.R: እነርሱም ደነገጡ፤ በጣምም ፈሩ። የሙት መንፈስ በዚያ የቆመ መሰላቸው።

decisions.choice: a spirit: a ghost, someone dead seen without a body
decisions.reason: The word is the usual word for spirit. Here it means the spirit of a dead person seen by the living, as Jesus' answer shows: a spirit has no flesh and bones (24:39).

decisions.choice: startled and terrified: fear that grows
decisions.reason: Two words are joined to show how great their fear was.

decisions.choice: a ghost
decisions.reason: Readable uses the everyday word for what they thought they saw; Literal and Balanced keep "spirit" to match Jesus' words in 24:39.

decisions.choice: roho (L, B); mzuka (R)
decisions.reason: The word is "spirit", here someone dead seen without a body (meaning decision m1). Literal and Balanced keep "roho", the human spirit; Readable says "mzuka" (ghost), as the English Readable says "ghost". "Pepo" would mean a demon. The same in verse 39.

decisions.choice: "một linh hồn" (L, B); "ma" (R) for "a spirit"
decisions.reason: A dead person seen without a body (meaning decision); "thần linh" would suggest a god, and Readable uses the everyday word for a ghost, as the English Readable does. Also in 24:39.

decisions.choice: "영" (L, B); "유령" (R) for pneuma, here and in 24:39
decisions.reason: A spirit seen without a body (meaning decision); "영" keeps the word Jesus takes up in 24:39, and Readable says "ghost", as the English Readable does. "귀신" is kept for demons.

decisions.choice: "መንፈስ" (L, B); "የሙት መንፈስ" (the spirit of a dead person, a ghost) (R)
decisions.reason: They thought they saw a dead man without a body; Readable makes that plain with "የሙት መንፈስ", as the English Readable says "ghost". The same words are used in 24:39.

source.text: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Τί τεταραγμένοι ἐστέ, καὶ διὰ τί διαλογισμοὶ ἀναβαίνουσιν ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ ὑμῶν;

records.literal_gloss: And he said to them, Why troubled are you, and for what reason doubts come up in the heart of you?

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "Why are you troubled, and for what reason do doubts rise up in your heart?
en.B: He said to them, "Why are you so shaken? Why are these doubts coming up in your hearts?
en.R: Jesus said to them, "Why are you so upset? Why do you have doubts in your hearts?

es.L: Y les dijo: «¿Por qué {{plural_you:están|estáis}} turbados, y por qué suben dudas en {{plural_you:el corazón de ustedes|vuestro corazón}}?
es.B: Les dijo: «¿Por qué {{plural_you:están|estáis}} tan alterados? ¿Por qué {{plural_you:les|os}} vienen estas dudas al corazón?
es.R: Jesús les dijo: «¿Por qué {{plural_you:están|estáis}} tan asustados? ¿Por qué {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} dudas en el corazón?

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Pourquoi êtes-vous troublés, et pourquoi des doutes montent-ils dans votre cœur ?
fr.B: Il leur dit : « Pourquoi êtes-vous si bouleversés ? Pourquoi ces doutes surgissent-ils dans vos cœurs ?
fr.R: Jésus leur a dit : « Pourquoi êtes-vous si inquiets ? Pourquoi avez-vous des doutes dans vos cœurs ?

sw.L: Akawaambia, "Kwa nini mmefadhaika, na kwa sababu gani mashaka yanainuka moyoni mwenu?
sw.B: Akawaambia, "Mbona mmetaharuki hivyo? Kwa nini mioyo yenu ina mashaka haya?
sw.R: Yesu akawaambia, "Mbona mmeshtuka hivyo? Kwa nini mna mashaka mioyoni mwenu?

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Sao các con bối rối, và vì sao những nghi ngờ nổi lên trong lòng các con?
vi.B: Ngài nói với họ: "Sao các con hoảng hốt như vậy? Sao lòng các con lại khởi lên những nghi ngờ?
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nói với họ: "Sao các con lo sợ như vậy? Sao các con lại nghi ngờ trong lòng?

ko.L: 그러자 그분이 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "어찌하여 너희가 불안해하느냐? 그리고 어찌하여 너희 마음에 의심이 일어나느냐?
ko.B: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "왜 그렇게 당황하느냐? 왜 마음에 의심이 생기느냐?
ko.R: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "왜 그렇게 놀라느냐? 왜 마음속으로 의심하느냐?

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes disse: "Por que vocês estão perturbados, e por que surgem dúvidas no coração de vocês?
pt.B: Ele lhes disse: "Por que vocês estão tão assustados? Por que essas dúvidas estão surgindo no coração de vocês?
pt.R: Jesus disse a eles: "Por que vocês estão tão perturbados? Por que estão com dúvidas no coração?

am.L: እርሱም እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «ለምን ትደነግጣላችሁ? ለምንስ በልባችሁ ጥርጣሬ ይነሣል?
am.B: እርሱም እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «ለምን እንዲህ ትደናገጣላችሁ? ይህስ ጥርጣሬ በልባችሁ ውስጥ ለምን ይነሣል?
am.R: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «ለምን ትረበሻላችሁ? በልባችሁ ውስጥ ለምን ትጠራጠራላችሁ?

decisions.choice: doubts: questioning thoughts
decisions.reason: The word is used for inner reasoning, often for thoughts that question or resist (2:35; 5:22). They cannot believe what they see.

decisions.choice: your heart: singular, the heart of the group
decisions.reason: The Greek often uses the singular for something each person in a group has.

decisions.choice: hearts
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the plural for the heart of each person present.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:el corazón de ustedes|vuestro corazón}}
decisions.reason: The Greek has one heart for the group (meaning decision m2). With "su", the Latin American form could be read as "their heart", so the default spells it out.

decisions.choice: moyoni mwenu (in your heart, singular)
decisions.reason: The Greek has one heart for the group (meaning decision m2), and Swahili can say so naturally, so Literal keeps the singular; Balanced and Readable use the plural, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "các con" for Jesus to the disciples
decisions.reason: As the risen Jesus speaks to his disciples in John 20:19 and 21:5.

decisions.choice: no coração de vocês (B); no coração (R)
decisions.reason: The English Balanced and Readable say "hearts". Portuguese uses the singular for something each person in a group has ("lavaram o rosto"), so the singular of the Greek (m2) reads naturally at every level.

source.text: ἴδετε τὰς χεῖράς μου καὶ τοὺς πόδας μου ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι αὐτός· ψηλαφήσατέ με καὶ ἴδετε, ὅτι πνεῦμα σάρκα καὶ ὀστέα οὐκ ἔχει καθὼς ἐμὲ θεωρεῖτε ἔχοντα.

records.literal_gloss: See the hands of me and the feet of me, that I am he myself; touch me and see, because a spirit flesh and bones not has as me you see having.

en.L: See {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hands and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} feet, that it is I {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}}; touch {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and see, because a spirit does not have flesh and bones, as you see that I have."
en.B: Look at {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hands and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} feet, and see that it is really I. Feel {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and see. Spirits have no flesh and bones; you can see that I do."
en.R: Look at {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hands and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} feet! It is really {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}! Touch {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and see. A ghost does not have a body of flesh and bones, but you can see that I do."

es.L: {{plural_you:Vean|Ved}} {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} manos y {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} pies: soy yo, el mismo. {{plural_you:Tóquenme|Tocadme}} y {{plural_you:vean|ved}}, porque un espíritu no tiene carne y huesos, según {{plural_you:observan|observáis}} que tengo yo».
es.B: {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}} {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} manos y {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} pies, y {{plural_you:vean|ved}} que de verdad soy yo. {{plural_you:Pálpenme|Palpadme}} y {{plural_you:compruébenlo|comprobadlo}}. Los espíritus no tienen carne ni huesos, y {{plural_you:pueden|podéis}} ver que yo sí los tengo».
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}} {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} manos y {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} pies! ¡Soy yo de verdad! {{plural_you:Tóquenme|Tocadme}} y {{plural_you:vean|ved}}. Un fantasma no tiene un cuerpo de carne y huesos, pero {{plural_you:pueden|podéis}} ver que yo sí lo tengo».

fr.L: Voyez {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} mains et {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} pieds : c’est bien {{deity_pronoun:moi-même|Moi-même}} ; touchez-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} et voyez, car un esprit n’a ni chair ni os, comme vous voyez que j’en ai. »
fr.B: Regardez {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} mains et {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} pieds : c’est bien {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. Palpez-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} et voyez. Un esprit n’a ni chair ni os, et vous voyez que j’en ai. »
fr.R: Regardez {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} mains et {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} pieds ! C’est vraiment {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ! Touchez-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} et voyez. Un fantôme n’a pas un corps de chair et d’os, mais vous voyez que {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, j’en ai un. »

sw.L: Oneni mikono {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} na miguu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, kwamba ni {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}; nipapaseni, mtazame, kwa sababu roho haina nyama wala mifupa, kama mnavyoona kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ninavyo."
sw.B: Tazameni mikono {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} na miguu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, mjue kwamba ni {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} kweli. Nipapaseni muone. Roho haina nyama na mifupa, lakini mnaona kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} nina nyama na mifupa."
sw.R: Tazameni mikono {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} na miguu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}! Ni {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} kweli! Niguseni, mwone. Mzuka hauna mwili wa nyama na mifupa, lakini mnaweza kuona kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ninao."

vi.L: Hãy xem tay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và chân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, rằng chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đây; hãy sờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và xem, vì linh hồn không có thịt và xương như các con thấy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} có."
vi.B: Hãy nhìn tay và chân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và thấy rằng đúng là chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Hãy sờ vào {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà xem. Linh hồn không có thịt và xương, như các con thấy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} có đây."
vi.R: Hãy nhìn tay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và chân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}! Đúng là {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đây mà! Hãy sờ vào {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và nhìn xem. Ma thì không có thân thể bằng thịt và xương, nhưng các con thấy đó, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} có."

ko.L: 내 손과 내 발을 보아라. 바로 나 자신이다. 나를 만져 보아라. 그리고 보아라. 영은 살과 뼈가 없으나, 너희가 보는 대로 나에게는 [살과 뼈가] 있다."
ko.B: 내 손과 발을 보아라. 바로 나다. 나를 만져 보아라. 영에게는 살과 뼈가 없다. 그러나 너희가 보는 것처럼 나에게는 있다."
ko.R: 내 손과 발을 보아라! 정말 나다! 나를 만져 보아라. 유령에게는 살과 뼈로 된 몸이 없다. 그러나 너희가 보다시피 나에게는 있다."

pt.L: Vejam as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} mãos e os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} pés, que sou eu mesmo; toquem-{{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} e vejam, porque um espírito não tem carne nem ossos, como vocês veem que eu tenho."
pt.B: Olhem as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} mãos e os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} pés e vejam que sou eu mesmo. Apalpem-{{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} e vejam. Um espírito não tem carne nem ossos, e vocês podem ver que eu tenho."
pt.R: Olhem as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} mãos e os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} pés! Sou eu mesmo! Toquem em {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} e vejam. Um fantasma não tem um corpo de carne e ossos, mas vocês podem ver que eu tenho."

am.L: እኔ ራሴ እንደ ሆንኩ እጆቼንና እግሮቼን እዩ፤ ዳስሱኝና እዩ፤ እኔ እንዳለኝ እንደምታዩት መንፈስ ሥጋና አጥንት የለውምና።»
am.B: እጆቼንና እግሮቼን ተመልከቱ፤ በእርግጥ እኔ መሆኔን እዩ። ዳስሱኝና እዩ፤ መንፈስ ሥጋና አጥንት የለውም፤ እኔ ግን እንዳለኝ ታያላችሁ።»
am.R: እጆቼንና እግሮቼን ተመልከቱ! በእርግጥ እኔ ነኝ! ንኩኝና እዩ። የሙት መንፈስ ሥጋና አጥንት ያለው አካል የለውም፤ እኔ ግን እንዳለኝ ታያላችሁ።»

decisions.choice: my hands and my feet: the marks that show who he is
alternatives: his hands and feet as proof of a body only
decisions.reason: The hands and feet had been nailed to the cross. John tells that Jesus showed the marks of the nails (John 20:20, 25-27). Luke does not mention the wounds, but the hands and feet show that this is the same Jesus who was crucified.

decisions.choice: it is I myself: the same person, not another
decisions.reason: The words stress identity: the one they see is the very one they knew.

decisions.choice: touch: handle, feel with the hands
decisions.reason: The verb is used for feeling something to find out what it is. 1 John 1:1 speaks of what "our hands have touched".

decisions.choice: flesh and bones: the risen Jesus has a real body
alternatives: a body that only looks real
decisions.reason: Jesus is not a ghost or a vision. He has been raised in the body that was buried, and he can be touched and can eat (24:42-43; Acts 1:3; 10:41).

decisions.choice: Feel me
decisions.reason: Balanced brings out that they are to handle him to find out that he is solid.

decisions.choice: a ghost
decisions.reason: Readable uses "ghost", as in 24:37.

decisions.choice: soy yo, with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: Jesus's own "yo" takes no span, as his "I" has none in English. The English Readable marks "It is really Me", but Spanish says "soy yo", with the subject pronoun.

decisions.choice: nipapaseni
decisions.reason: The verb means to handle, to feel with the hands (meaning decision m3), which "kupapasa" says; Readable uses the plainer "niguseni" (touch me), as the English does.

decisions.choice: [살과 뼈가]
decisions.reason: The Greek says only "as you see me having"; Korean needs what he has.

source.text: καὶ τοῦτο εἰπὼν ἔδειξεν αὐτοῖς τὰς χεῖρας καὶ τοὺς πόδας.

records.literal_gloss: And this having said he showed to them the hands and the feet.

en.L: And having said this, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} showed them [{{deity_pronoun:his|His}}] hands and feet.
en.B: After saying this, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} let them see {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hands and feet.
en.R: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} showed them {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hands and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} feet.

es.L: Y habiendo dicho esto, les mostró las manos y los pies.
es.B: Dicho esto, les dejó ver {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} manos y pies.
es.R: Entonces les mostró {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} manos y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} pies.

fr.L: Et, ayant dit cela, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur montra les mains et les pieds.
fr.B: Après avoir dit cela, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur fit voir {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} mains et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} pieds.
fr.R: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur a montré {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} mains et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} pieds.

sw.L: Na alipokwisha kusema hayo, aliwaonyesha mikono na miguu.
sw.B: Baada ya kusema hayo, aliwaonyesha mikono na miguu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: Kisha akawaonyesha mikono {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} na miguu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.

vi.L: Và nói điều này xong, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho họ xem tay và chân [của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}].
vi.B: Nói xong, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho họ xem tay và chân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho họ xem tay và chân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그리고 이 말씀을 하시고, 그들에게 손과 발을 보여 주셨다.
ko.B: 이렇게 말씀하시고 나서, 예수께서 그들에게 두 손과 두 발을 보여 주셨다.
ko.R: 그리고 예수께서는 자신의 손과 발을 그들에게 보여 주셨다.

pt.L: E, tendo dito isso, mostrou-lhes as [{{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}}] mãos e os pés.
pt.B: Depois de dizer isso, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} deixou que vissem as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} mãos e os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} pés.
pt.R: Então {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} mostrou a eles as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} mãos e os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} pés.

am.L: ይህንም ብሎ እጆቹንና እግሮቹን አሳያቸው።
am.B: ይህን ከተናገረ በኋላ እጆቹንና እግሮቹን አሳያቸው።
am.R: ከዚያም እጆቹንና እግሮቹን አሳያቸው።

decisions.choice: the verse is included, as in the SBLGNT
alternatives: the verse is left out, as in Codex Bezae and some Old Latin and Syriac manuscripts
decisions.reason: Almost all manuscripts, the early papyrus P75 among them, have the verse. Codex Bezae, some Old Latin manuscripts and some early Syriac manuscripts lack it. Some think it was added from John 20:20, where Jesus shows his hands and side; but Luke has hands and feet, as in 24:39. Codex Bezae and some Old Latin manuscripts, known as Western witnesses, usually have a longer text than other manuscripts, but near the end of Luke they have a shorter text in several places. Where witnesses that tend to add leave something out, the shorter reading may be the original. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: las manos y los pies, with no bracket
decisions.reason: Spanish, like Greek, uses the article for parts of the body, so Literal needs no supplied possessive where the English brackets "[His]", as in John 20:20.

decisions.choice: les mains et les pieds (L), with no bracketed possessive
alternatives: [ses] mains et [ses] pieds, as the English Literal
decisions.reason: The Greek has the article only. French, like Greek, uses the article for parts of the body when the owner is plain, so Literal can follow it without supplying "his"; Balanced and Readable say "ses", with the pronoun setting.

decisions.choice: mikono na miguu, with no bracket
decisions.reason: Swahili reads naturally without a possessive here, so Literal needs none where the English brackets "[His]", as in John 20:20.

source.text: ἔτι δὲ ἀπιστούντων αὐτῶν ἀπὸ τῆς χαρᾶς καὶ θαυμαζόντων εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Ἔχετέ τι βρώσιμον ἐνθάδε;

records.literal_gloss: Still now disbelieving them for the joy and marveling he said to them, Have you anything to eat here?

en.L: And while they were still not believing for joy, and were marveling, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "Do you have anything to eat here?"
en.B: Their joy and amazement were so great that they still could not believe it. Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} asked them, "Do you have something here to eat?"
en.R: They were so full of joy and amazement that they still could not believe it was true. Jesus asked them, "Do you have any food here?"

es.L: Y como ellos todavía no creían por la alegría, y estaban maravillados, les dijo: «¿{{plural_you:Tienen|Tenéis}} aquí algo de comer?».
es.B: Era tanta su alegría y su asombro que todavía no podían creerlo. Entonces les preguntó: «¿{{plural_you:Tienen|Tenéis}} aquí algo que comer?».
es.R: Estaban tan llenos de alegría y asombro que todavía no podían creer que fuera verdad. Jesús les preguntó: «¿{{plural_you:Tienen|Tenéis}} algo de comer aquí?».

fr.L: Et comme ils ne croyaient pas encore, de joie, et s’étonnaient, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Avez-vous ici quelque chose à manger ? »
fr.B: Leur joie et leur étonnement étaient si grands qu’ils n’arrivaient pas encore à croire. Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur demanda : « Avez-vous ici de quoi manger ? »
fr.R: Ils étaient si pleins de joie et si étonnés qu’ils n’arrivaient toujours pas à croire que c’était vrai. Jésus leur a demandé : « Est-ce que vous avez quelque chose à manger ici ? »

sw.L: Nao walipokuwa bado hawaamini kwa sababu ya furaha, na wakistaajabu, akawaambia, "Mna chochote cha kula hapa?"
sw.B: Furaha na mshangao wao ulikuwa mkubwa kiasi kwamba bado hawakuweza kuamini. Kisha akawauliza, "Mna kitu cha kula hapa?"
sw.R: Walijaa furaha na mshangao kiasi kwamba bado hawakuweza kuamini kuwa ni kweli. Yesu akawauliza, "Mna chakula chochote hapa?"

vi.L: Trong khi họ vẫn chưa tin vì vui mừng và đang kinh ngạc, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Các con có gì ăn ở đây không?"
vi.B: Họ vui mừng và kinh ngạc đến nỗi vẫn chưa dám tin. Bấy giờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hỏi họ: "Ở đây các con có gì ăn không?"
vi.R: Họ vui mừng và ngạc nhiên đến nỗi vẫn chưa thể tin đó là sự thật. Đức Giê-xu hỏi họ: "Các con có gì ăn ở đây không?"

ko.L: 그들이 기뻐서 아직 믿지 못하고 놀라워하고 있을 때에, 그분이 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "너희에게 여기 먹을 것이 좀 있느냐?"
ko.B: 그들은 너무 기쁘고 놀라워서 아직도 믿기지 않았다. 그때 예수께서 그들에게 물으셨다. "여기 먹을 것이 좀 있느냐?"
ko.R: 그들은 기쁘고 놀라워서 그것이 정말인지 아직 믿기지가 않았다. 예수께서 그들에게 물으셨다. "여기 먹을 것이 있느냐?"

pt.L: E, como eles ainda não criam por causa da alegria e estavam admirados, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes disse: "Vocês têm aqui alguma coisa para comer?"
pt.B: A alegria e o espanto deles eram tão grandes que eles ainda não conseguiam crer. Então {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes perguntou: "Vocês têm aqui alguma coisa para comer?"
pt.R: Eles estavam tão cheios de alegria e de espanto que ainda não conseguiam acreditar que aquilo era verdade. Jesus perguntou a eles: "Vocês têm alguma comida aqui?"

am.L: እነርሱም ከደስታቸው የተነሣ ገና ሳያምኑና ሲደነቁ ሳሉ፦ «በዚህ የሚበላ ነገር አላችሁን?» አላቸው።
am.B: ደስታቸውና መገረማቸው እጅግ ታላቅ ስለ ነበረ ገና ማመን አልቻሉም። እርሱም፦ «በዚህ የሚበላ ነገር አላችሁ?» ብሎ ጠየቃቸው።
am.R: በጣም ተደስተውና ተደንቀው ስለ ነበር ይህ እውነት መሆኑን ገና ማመን አልቻሉም። ኢየሱስም፦ «እዚህ ምግብ አላችሁ?» ብሎ ጠየቃቸው።

decisions.choice: not believing for joy: it seemed too good to be true
decisions.reason: Their doubt now comes from joy, not from fear. Luke says the same of Rhoda, who was so glad to hear Peter that she did not open the door (Acts 12:14).

decisions.choice: Do you have anything to eat: food to show that he has a real body
decisions.reason: Eating in front of them gives them another sign that he is not a spirit. Peter later says that the apostles ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead (Acts 10:41).

decisions.choice: the reason first, then the result
alternatives: while they were still not believing for joy
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable spell out that their joy kept them from believing.

source.text: οἱ δὲ ἐπέδωκαν αὐτῷ ἰχθύος ὀπτοῦ μέρος·

records.literal_gloss: They and gave to him of a fish broiled a piece;

en.L: And they gave {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} a piece of a broiled fish.
en.B: They handed {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} a piece of grilled fish.
en.R: They gave {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} a piece of cooked fish.

es.L: Y ellos {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dieron un trozo de pescado asado.
es.B: Ellos {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pasaron un trozo de pescado asado.
es.R: Ellos {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dieron un pedazo de pescado cocinado.

fr.L: Et ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} donnèrent un morceau de poisson grillé.
fr.B: Ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} présentèrent un morceau de poisson grillé.
fr.R: Ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ont donné un morceau de poisson cuit.

sw.L: Nao wakampa kipande cha samaki aliyechomwa.
sw.B: Wakampa kipande cha samaki wa kuchoma.
sw.R: Wakampa kipande cha samaki aliyepikwa.

vi.L: Họ đưa cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} một miếng cá nướng.
vi.B: Họ trao cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} một miếng cá nướng.
vi.R: Họ đưa cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} một miếng cá đã nấu chín.

ko.L: 그러자 그들이 구운 생선 한 토막을 그분께 드렸다.
ko.B: 그들이 구운 생선 한 토막을 예수께 드렸다.
ko.R: 그들은 구운 생선 한 조각을 예수께 드렸다.

pt.L: E eles {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} deram um pedaço de peixe assado.
pt.B: Eles {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} deram um pedaço de peixe grelhado.
pt.R: Eles {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} deram um pedaço de peixe assado.

am.L: እነርሱም የተጠበሰ ዓሣ ቁራጭ ሰጡት።
am.B: እነርሱም የተጠበሰ ዓሣ ቁራጭ ሰጡት።
am.R: እነርሱም የበሰለ ዓሣ ቁራጭ ሰጡት።

decisions.choice: a piece of broiled fish: the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: a piece of broiled fish and some honeycomb, the reading of many later manuscripts
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts add "and some honeycomb". The earliest manuscripts lack it. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: broiled: cooked over a fire
decisions.reason: Fish from the Lake of Galilee was a common food, often cooked over coals (John 21:9).

source.text: καὶ λαβὼν ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν ἔφαγεν.

records.literal_gloss: And having taken [it] before them he ate.

en.L: And taking [it], {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} ate [it] before them.
en.B: He took it and ate it while they watched.
en.R: Jesus took it and ate it while they watched.

es.L: Y, tomando [el pescado], [lo] comió delante de ellos.
es.B: Lo tomó y lo comió mientras ellos observaban.
es.R: Jesús lo tomó y lo comió mientras ellos observaban.

fr.L: Et, l’ayant pris, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} mangea devant eux.
fr.B: Il le prit et le mangea sous leurs yeux.
fr.R: Jésus l’a pris et l’a mangé pendant qu’ils {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} regardaient.

sw.L: Akakitwaa, akakila mbele yao.
sw.B: Akakichukua, akakila wakimtazama.
sw.R: Yesu akakichukua, akakila huku wao wakimtazama.

vi.L: Và cầm lấy, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ăn trước mặt họ.
vi.B: Ngài cầm lấy và ăn trước mặt họ.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu cầm lấy và ăn trong khi họ nhìn xem.

ko.L: 그리고 받아서 그들 앞에서 잡수셨다.
ko.B: 예수께서는 그것을 받아 그들이 보는 앞에서 잡수셨다.
ko.R: 예수께서는 그것을 받아서 그들이 보는 앞에서 잡수셨다.

pt.L: E, tomando-[o], {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} [o] comeu diante deles.
pt.B: Ele pegou o peixe e o comeu enquanto eles olhavam.
pt.R: Jesus pegou o peixe e comeu na frente deles.

am.L: ተቀብሎም በፊታቸው በላ።
am.B: እርሱም ተቀብሎ እያዩት በላው።
am.R: ኢየሱስም ተቀብሎ እያዩት በላው።

decisions.choice: before them: in front of them, as witnesses
decisions.reason: Luke stresses that they saw him eat. They are to be witnesses (24:48).

source.text: Εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτούς· Οὗτοι οἱ λόγοι μου οὓς ἐλάλησα πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἔτι ὢν σὺν ὑμῖν, ὅτι δεῖ πληρωθῆναι πάντα τὰ γεγραμμένα ἐν τῷ νόμῳ Μωϋσέως καὶ προφήταις καὶ ψαλμοῖς περὶ ἐμοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: He said then to them, These [are] the words of me which I spoke to you still being with you, that it is necessary to be fulfilled all things having been written in the law of Moses and Prophets and Psalms concerning me.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "These [are] {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} words that I spoke to you while I was still with you, that all the things written about {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} in the Law of Moses and the Prophets and the Psalms must be fulfilled."
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "This is what I was telling you when I was still with you: whatever the Law of Moses, the Prophets and the Psalms have written about {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} must be fulfilled."
en.R: Then Jesus said to them, "This is what I was telling you when I was with you before. Everything written about {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} in the Law of Moses, in the books of the prophets, and in the Psalms must come true."

es.L: Y les dijo: «Estas [son] {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} palabras, las que {{plural_you:les|os}} dije cuando todavía estaba con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}: que tiene que cumplirse todo lo escrito sobre {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} en la Ley de Moisés y [en los] Profetas y [en los] Salmos».
es.B: Luego les dijo: «Esto es lo que {{plural_you:les|os}} decía cuando aún estaba con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}: todo lo que está escrito acerca de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} en la Ley de Moisés, en los Profetas y en los Salmos tiene que cumplirse».
es.R: Entonces Jesús les dijo: «Esto es lo que {{plural_you:les|os}} decía cuando estaba antes con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Todo lo que está escrito sobre {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} en la Ley de Moisés, en los libros de los profetas y en los Salmos tiene que hacerse realidad».

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Ce [sont] là {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} paroles, que je vous ai dites quand j’étais encore avec vous : il faut que s’accomplisse tout ce qui est écrit à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} sujet dans la Loi de Moïse, et les Prophètes, et les Psaumes. »
fr.B: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Voilà ce que je vous disais quand j’étais encore avec vous : tout ce que la Loi de Moïse, les Prophètes et les Psaumes ont écrit à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} sujet doit s’accomplir. »
fr.R: Puis Jésus leur a dit : « C’est ce que je vous disais quand j’étais avec vous auparavant. Tout ce qui est écrit sur {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} dans la Loi de Moïse, dans les livres des prophètes et dans les Psaumes doit se réaliser. »

sw.L: Akawaambia, "Haya [ni] maneno {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} ambayo nilisema nanyi nikiwa bado pamoja nanyi, kwamba ni lazima yatimizwe yote yaliyoandikwa juu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} katika Sheria ya Musa na Manabii na Zaburi."
sw.B: Kisha akawaambia, "Hili ndilo nililokuwa nikiwaambia nilipokuwa bado pamoja nanyi: kila kilichoandikwa juu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} katika Sheria ya Musa, katika Manabii na katika Zaburi lazima kitimie."
sw.R: Kisha Yesu akawaambia, "Hiki ndicho nilichowaambia nilipokuwa pamoja nanyi zamani. Kila kitu kilichoandikwa juu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} katika Sheria ya Musa, katika vitabu vya manabii, na katika Zaburi, lazima kitimie."

vi.L: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Đây là những lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã nói với các con khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} còn ở với các con, rằng mọi điều đã chép về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trong luật pháp Môi-se, các sách tiên tri và các Thi Thiên đều phải được ứng nghiệm."
vi.B: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Đây là điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã nói với các con khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} còn ở với các con: mọi điều đã chép về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trong luật pháp Môi-se, các sách tiên tri và sách Thi Thiên đều phải được ứng nghiệm."
vi.R: Rồi Đức Giê-xu nói với họ: "Đây là điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã nói với các con khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} còn ở với các con trước đây: Mọi điều viết về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trong luật pháp Môi-se, trong các sách của các nhà tiên tri và trong sách Thi Thiên đều phải xảy ra đúng như vậy."

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "이것이 내가 아직 너희와 함께 있을 때에 너희에게 한 내 말이다. 곧 모세의 율법과 예언자들과 시편에 나에 관하여 기록된 모든 것이 반드시 이루어져야 한다는 것이다."
ko.B: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "내가 전에 너희와 함께 있을 때에 너희에게 한 말이 바로 이것이다. 모세의 율법과 예언서와 시편에 나에 관하여 기록된 것은 모두 이루어져야 한다."
ko.R: 그리고 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "이것은 내가 전에 너희와 함께 있을 때 너희에게 했던 말이다. 모세의 율법과 예언자들의 책과 시편에 나에 관하여 쓰인 것은 모두 반드시 이루어져야 한다."

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes disse: "Estas [são] as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} palavras que eu lhes falei quando ainda estava com vocês: que é necessário que se cumpram todas as coisas escritas a {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} respeito na Lei de Moisés, e nos Profetas, e nos Salmos."
pt.B: Depois {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes disse: "Era isto que eu lhes dizia quando ainda estava com vocês: tudo o que está escrito a {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} respeito na Lei de Moisés, nos Profetas e nos Salmos tem de se cumprir."
pt.R: Depois Jesus disse a eles: "Era isto que eu dizia a vocês quando estava com vocês antes. Tudo o que está escrito sobre {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} na Lei de Moisés, nos livros dos profetas e nos Salmos precisa acontecer."

am.L: እርሱም እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «ገና ከእናንተ ጋር ሳለሁ የነገርኋችሁ ቃሎቼ እነዚህ [ናቸው]፤ ይኸውም በሙሴ ሕግና በነቢያት በመዝሙራትም ስለ እኔ የተጻፈው ሁሉ ሊፈጸም ይገባዋል የሚለው ነው።»
am.B: ከዚያም እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «ገና ከእናንተ ጋር ሳለሁ የነገርኋችሁ ይህ ነው፤ በሙሴ ሕግ፣ በነቢያትና በመዝሙራት ስለ እኔ የተጻፈው ሁሉ ሊፈጸም ይገባዋል።»
am.R: ከዚያም ኢየሱስ እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «ቀደም ሲል ከእናንተ ጋር ሳለሁ የነገርኋችሁ ይህ ነው። በሙሴ ሕግ፣ በነቢያት መጻሕፍትና በመዝሙራት ስለ እኔ የተጻፈው ሁሉ መፈጸም አለበት።»

decisions.choice: while I was still with you: before his death
alternatives: while he was still on earth
decisions.reason: Jesus is with them now, but not as he was before. His time of living and traveling with them came to an end at the cross.

decisions.choice: the Law of Moses and the Prophets and the Psalms: the whole of the Hebrew Scriptures
decisions.reason: The Hebrew Scriptures were grouped as the Law, the Prophets and the Writings. The Psalms were the largest and best known of the Writings, and the name could stand for the whole group. Jesus names every part of Scripture.

decisions.choice: must be fulfilled: by God's purpose
decisions.reason: The same word of necessity as in 24:7 and 24:26. What God has said in Scripture has to come to pass.

decisions.choice: these are my words: the warnings he gave about his suffering and rising
decisions.reason: Jesus refers to what he said many times (9:22, 9:44; 18:31-33; 22:37).

decisions.choice: come true
decisions.reason: Readable uses an everyday phrase for being fulfilled.

decisions.choice: the books of the prophets
decisions.reason: Readable says that the Prophets are part of the Scriptures.

decisions.choice: "luật pháp Môi-se", "các sách tiên tri", "Thi Thiên"
decisions.reason: The three parts of the Hebrew Scriptures (meaning decision); "luật pháp" stays lowercase as the style guide says, and "Thi Thiên" is the Protestant name of the Psalms.

decisions.choice: "được ứng nghiệm" (L, B); "xảy ra đúng như vậy" (R)
decisions.reason: The word settled for fulfilled prophecy in the Vietnamese Matthew; Readable says it plainly, as the English Readable says "come true".

decisions.choice: "예언자들" (L), "예언서" (B), "예언자들의 책" (R); "시편"; "이루어지다" for pleroo
decisions.reason: The three parts of the Hebrew Scriptures (meaning decision); Balanced uses the Korean name for the prophetic books. "이루어지다" is the word settled for fulfilment in the Korean Matthew.

decisions.choice: "መዝሙራት" (the Psalms)
alternatives: "መዝሙረ ዳዊት" (the traditional name of the book)
decisions.reason: The Greek names the Psalms as one part of the Scriptures beside the Law and the Prophets; "መዝሙራት" says that plainly, while "መዝሙረ ዳዊት" is the Ge'ez-shaped book title.

source.text: τότε διήνοιξεν αὐτῶν τὸν νοῦν τοῦ συνιέναι τὰς γραφάς, καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὅτι οὕτως γέγραπται παθεῖν τὸν χριστὸν καὶ ἀναστῆναι ἐκ νεκρῶν τῇ τρίτῃ ἡμέρᾳ, καὶ κηρυχθῆναι ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ μετάνοιαν καὶ ἄφεσιν ἁμαρτιῶν εἰς πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ἀρξάμενοι ἀπὸ Ἰερουσαλήμ·

records.literal_gloss: Then he opened of them the mind to understand the Scriptures, \v 46 and he said to them that thus it has been written to suffer the Christ and to rise out from [the] dead the third day, \v 47 and to be proclaimed in the name of him repentance and forgiveness of sins to all the nations, having begun from Jerusalem;

en.L: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} opened their mind to understand the Scriptures, \v 46 and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "Thus it is written, that the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} is to suffer and to rise from [the] dead on the third day, \v 47 and that repentance and forgiveness of sins are to be proclaimed in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name to all the nations, beginning from Jerusalem.
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} opened their minds to make sense of the Scriptures. \v 46 He told them, "This is what stands written: {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} is to suffer and to rise from the dead on the third day, \v 47 and in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name repentance and the forgiveness of sins are to be announced to all the nations, starting from Jerusalem.
en.R: Then Jesus helped them understand the Scriptures. \v 46 He said to them, "This is what the Scriptures say: {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} would suffer and then rise from the dead on the third day. \v 47 And in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name, people of every nation will be told to turn away from their sins and be forgiven. This will begin in Jerusalem.

es.L: Entonces les abrió el entendimiento para que comprendieran las Escrituras, \v 46 y les dijo: «Así está escrito: que el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} había de padecer y levantarse de entre [los] muertos al tercer día, \v 47 y que en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre había de proclamarse arrepentimiento y perdón de pecados a todas las naciones, empezando por Jerusalén.
es.B: Entonces les abrió la mente para que entendieran las Escrituras, \v 46 y les dijo: «Esto es lo que dicen las Escrituras: el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} tiene que padecer y resucitar de entre los muertos al tercer día, \v 47 y en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre se ha de anunciar a todas las naciones el arrepentimiento y el perdón de los pecados, comenzando por Jerusalén.
es.R: Entonces Jesús les ayudó a entender las Escrituras. \v 46 Les dijo: «Esto es lo que dicen las Escrituras: el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} sufriría y luego resucitaría de entre los muertos al tercer día. \v 47 Y en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre se anunciará a la gente de todas las naciones que deben apartarse de sus pecados para recibir el perdón. Esto comenzará en Jerusalén.

fr.L: Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur ouvrit l’intelligence pour comprendre les Écritures, \v 46 et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Ainsi il est écrit que le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} doit souffrir et ressusciter d’entre les morts le troisième jour, \v 47 et que la repentance et le pardon des péchés doivent être proclamés en {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom à toutes les nations, à commencer par Jérusalem.
fr.B: Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur ouvrit l’esprit pour qu’ils comprennent les Écritures. \v 46 Il leur dit : « Voici ce qui est écrit : le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} doit souffrir et ressusciter d’entre les morts le troisième jour, \v 47 et en {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom la repentance et le pardon des péchés doivent être annoncés à toutes les nations, en commençant par Jérusalem.
fr.R: Alors Jésus les a aidés à comprendre les Écritures. \v 46 Il leur a dit : « Voici ce que disent les Écritures : le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} allait souffrir, puis revenir à la vie le troisième jour. \v 47 Et en {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom, on va dire aux gens de tous les peuples de se détourner de leurs péchés pour être pardonnés. Cela va commencer à Jérusalem.

sw.L: Kisha akaifungua akili yao ili wayaelewe Maandiko, \v 46 akawaambia, "Imeandikwa hivi: kwamba {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} lazima apate mateso na afufuke kutoka kwa wafu siku ya tatu, \v 47 na kwamba kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} toba na msamaha wa dhambi vihubiriwe kwa mataifa yote, kuanzia Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Kisha akafungua akili zao waweze kuyaelewa Maandiko. \v 46 Akawaambia, "Maandiko yanasema hivi: {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} atapata mateso, kisha atafufuka kutoka kwa wafu siku ya tatu; \v 47 na kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} mataifa yote yatatangaziwa toba na msamaha wa dhambi, kuanzia Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Kisha Yesu akawasaidia kuyaelewa Maandiko. \v 46 Akawaambia, "Maandiko yanasema hivi: {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} angeteswa, kisha angefufuka kutoka kwa wafu siku ya tatu. \v 47 Na kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} watu wa kila taifa wataambiwa waache dhambi zao ili wasamehewe. Jambo hili litaanzia Yerusalemu.

vi.L: Bấy giờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mở trí họ để hiểu Kinh Thánh, \v 46 và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Có lời chép như vầy: {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} phải chịu khổ và sống lại từ [giữa] những người chết vào ngày thứ ba, \v 47 và sự ăn năn và sự tha tội phải được rao giảng trong danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho tất cả các dân tộc, bắt đầu từ Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mở trí cho họ hiểu Kinh Thánh. \v 46 Ngài nói với họ: "Kinh Thánh đã chép: {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} phải chịu khổ, rồi đến ngày thứ ba sống lại từ cõi chết; \v 47 và sự ăn năn cùng sự tha tội phải được rao giảng nhân danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho mọi dân tộc, bắt đầu từ Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Rồi Đức Giê-xu giúp họ hiểu Kinh Thánh. \v 46 Ngài nói với họ: "Kinh Thánh nói rằng {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} phải chịu khổ, rồi đến ngày thứ ba sống lại từ cõi chết. \v 47 Nhân danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, người ta sẽ rao báo cho mọi dân tộc rằng họ phải ăn năn, từ bỏ tội lỗi, để được tha tội. Việc này sẽ bắt đầu tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.

ko.L: 그때에 그분이 성경을 깨닫도록 그들의 마음을 열어 주시고, \v 46 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "이렇게 기록되어 있다. {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}는 고난을 받고 사흘째 되는 날에 죽은 사람들 가운데서 살아나야 하고, \v 47 그의 이름으로 회개와 죄 용서가 예루살렘에서부터 시작하여 모든 민족에게 선포되어야 한다.
ko.B: 그때 예수께서 그들의 마음을 열어 성경을 깨닫게 하셨다. \v 46 그리고 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "성경에 이렇게 기록되어 있다. {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}는 고난을 받고, 사흘째 되는 날에 죽은 사람들 가운데서 살아날 것이다. \v 47 그리고 그의 이름으로 회개와 죄 용서가 모든 민족에게 선포될 것인데, 예루살렘에서부터 시작될 것이다.
ko.R: 그리고 예수께서는 그들이 성경을 깨달을 수 있도록 도와주셨다. \v 46 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "성경에는 이렇게 쓰여 있다. {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}는 고난을 받고, 사흘째 되는 날에 죽음에서 다시 살아난다. \v 47 그리고 그의 이름으로 모든 민족에게 이 소식이 전해질 것이다. 죄에서 돌이켜 하나님께 돌아오면 죄를 용서받는다는 소식이다. 이 일은 예루살렘에서 시작될 것이다.

pt.L: Então {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes abriu a mente para entenderem as Escrituras \v 46 e lhes disse: "Assim está escrito: o {{christos:Cristo|Messias}} havia de sofrer e ressuscitar dentre [os] mortos ao terceiro dia, \v 47 e em {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome havia de ser proclamado o arrependimento e o perdão dos pecados a todas as nações, começando por Jerusalém.
pt.B: Então {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes abriu a mente para que entendessem as Escrituras. \v 46 Ele lhes disse: "Isto é o que está escrito: o {{christos:Cristo|Messias}} havia de sofrer e ressuscitar dentre os mortos no terceiro dia, \v 47 e em {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome o arrependimento e o perdão dos pecados seriam anunciados a todas as nações, a começar por Jerusalém.
pt.R: Então Jesus ajudou os discípulos a entender as Escrituras. \v 46 Ele disse a eles: "É isto o que as Escrituras dizem: o {{christos:Cristo|Messias}} ia sofrer e depois ressuscitar dentre os mortos no terceiro dia. \v 47 E em {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome as pessoas de todas as nações vão ouvir que devem deixar os seus pecados e voltar para Deus, para serem perdoadas. Isso vai começar em Jerusalém.

am.L: በዚያን ጊዜ መጻሕፍትን ያስተውሉ ዘንድ አእምሮአቸውን ከፈተላቸው፤ \v 46 እንዲህም አላቸው፦ «እንዲህ ተጽፏል፤ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} መከራ ይቀበላል፤ በሦስተኛውም ቀን ከሙታን ይነሣል፤ \v 47 ከኢየሩሳሌምም ጀምሮ በስሙ ንስሓና የኃጢአት ይቅርታ ለአሕዛብ ሁሉ ይሰበካል።
am.B: በዚያን ጊዜ መጻሕፍትን እንዲያስተውሉ አእምሮአቸውን ከፈተላቸው። \v 46 እንዲህም አላቸው፦ «የተጻፈው ይህ ነው፤ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} መከራ ይቀበላል፤ በሦስተኛው ቀን ከሙታን ይነሣል። \v 47 በስሙም ንስሓና የኃጢአት ይቅርታ ከኢየሩሳሌም ጀምሮ ለአሕዛብ ሁሉ ይታወጃል።
am.R: ከዚያም ኢየሱስ መጻሕፍትን እንዲረዱ አገዛቸው። \v 46 እንዲህም አላቸው፦ «ቅዱሳት መጻሕፍት የሚሉት ይህ ነው፤ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} መከራ ይቀበላል፤ ከዚያም በሦስተኛው ቀን ከሞት ይነሣል። \v 47 በስሙም ከየሕዝቡ ሁሉ ያሉ ሰዎች ንስሓ ገብተው የኃጢአታቸውን ይቅርታ እንዲያገኙ ይነገራቸዋል። ይህም ከኢየሩሳሌም ይጀምራል።

decisions.choice: opened their mind: gave them understanding
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for their eyes (24:31) and for the Scriptures (24:32). Understanding Scripture is given by the risen Lord, not only learned.

decisions.choice: thus it is written: the Scriptures as a whole, not one verse
decisions.reason: Jesus does not name a passage. In Acts the apostles point to passages such as Psalm 16 for his rising (Acts 2:25-31) and Isaiah 53 for his suffering (Acts 8:32-35).

decisions.choice: the Christ: the Messiah, God's anointed King
decisions.reason: With the article it is a title, as in 24:26.

decisions.choice: repentance and forgiveness of sins: turning back to God and being freed from sins
alternatives: a change of mind about Jesus only
decisions.reason: Repentance is a change of mind and life, a turning back to God (3:3, 8; 5:32). Forgiveness is a release from sins, as Zechariah foretold (1:77) and Jesus announced (4:18). The apostles preach both in Acts 2:38.

decisions.choice: repentance and forgiveness: the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: repentance for the forgiveness of sins, the reading of some early manuscripts
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts read "and". Some early ones, among them P75, Codex Sinaiticus and Codex Vaticanus, read "for": repentance that leads to forgiveness, as in 3:3. The meaning is close. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: all the nations: all peoples, the Gentiles included
alternatives: the Jewish people scattered among the nations
decisions.reason: Simeon said Jesus would be a light for revelation to the Gentiles (2:32). Acts tells how the message went from Jerusalem to the nations (Acts 1:8).

decisions.choice: beginning from Jerusalem: the starting point of the preaching
alternatives: the start of the next sentence: "Beginning from Jerusalem, you are witnesses"
decisions.reason: The word "beginning" is plural and could go with the witnesses in 24:48. The SBLGNT punctuation joins it to this sentence, where it says where the preaching starts.

decisions.choice: rise from the dead: come back to life
decisions.reason: The verb is active here, as in 18:33 and 24:7.

decisions.choice: This is what stands written (B); This is what the Scriptures say (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make the formula a full sentence and introduce what follows with a colon.

decisions.choice: will be told to turn away from their sins and be forgiven
alternatives: repentance and forgiveness of sins will be proclaimed
decisions.reason: Readable turns the nouns into verbs, which are easier to follow.

decisions.choice: then
decisions.reason: Readable makes the order of events plain, as at 24:26.

decisions.choice: Así está escrito (L); Esto es lo que dicen las Escrituras (B, R)
decisions.reason: The term chosen for the Gospels: Literal keeps the Greek formula; Balanced and Readable say plainly that it is the Scriptures that say it, as a whole rather than one verse (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: arrepentimiento
decisions.reason: The term chosen for the Gospels for turning back to God (meaning decision m4). Readable explains it as turning away from one's sins, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: Imeandikwa hivi (L); Maandiko yanasema hivi (B, R)
decisions.reason: The term chosen for the Gospels: Literal keeps the Greek formula; Balanced and Readable say plainly that it is the Scriptures that say it, as a whole rather than one verse (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: toba
decisions.reason: The term chosen for the Gospels for turning back to God (meaning decision m4). Readable explains it as leaving one's sins, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Có lời chép" (L); "Kinh Thánh đã chép" (B); "Kinh Thánh nói" (R)
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Luke 4:4 for "it is written".

decisions.choice: "sự ăn năn" and "sự tha tội"
decisions.reason: The words of John's preaching in the Vietnamese Luke 3:3; the SBLGNT has "and" between them (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "회개와 죄 용서" (L, B); "죄에서 돌이켜 하나님께 돌아오면 죄를 용서받는다" (R)
decisions.reason: The words of the Korean Luke 3:3 and 5:32; the SBLGNT has "and" between the two (meaning decision), which every level keeps.

decisions.choice: {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} with "는"; "사흘째 되는 날" as in 24:7; "그의 이름" with no honorific; "모든 민족" at every level
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks of the Christ, that is of himself, without the honorific; all the nations means all peoples, Gentiles included (meaning decision), so Korean does not narrow it to "이방인".

decisions.choice: "ንስሓና የኃጢአት ይቅርታ" (repentance and forgiveness of sins)
alternatives: "ስርየተ ኃጢአት" (the Ge'ez church phrase for forgiveness of sins)
decisions.reason: "የኃጢአት ይቅርታ" is the plain Amharic for being forgiven one's sins; "ንስሓ" is the key term for repentance at every level, Readable included.

source.text: ὑμεῖς ἐστε μάρτυρες τούτων.

records.literal_gloss: You [are] witnesses of these things.

en.L: You are witnesses of these things.
en.B: You are witnesses to these things.
en.R: You have seen all these things, and you are to tell others about them.

es.L: {{plural_you:Ustedes son|Vosotros sois}} testigos de estas cosas.
es.B: {{plural_you:Ustedes son|Vosotros sois}} testigos de todo esto.
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes han|Vosotros habéis}} visto todas estas cosas, y {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} contárselas a otros.

fr.L: Vous, vous êtes témoins de ces choses.
fr.B: C’est vous qui êtes les témoins de tout cela.
fr.R: Vous avez vu tout cela, et vous devez le raconter aux autres.

sw.L: Ninyi ni mashahidi wa mambo haya.
sw.B: Ninyi ni mashahidi wa mambo haya yote.
sw.R: Ninyi mmeyaona mambo haya yote, nanyi mnapaswa kuwaeleza wengine habari zake.

vi.L: Các con là nhân chứng về những điều này.
vi.B: Chính các con là những nhân chứng về các việc này.
vi.R: Các con đã thấy tất cả những việc này, và các con phải đi nói cho người khác biết.

ko.L: 너희는 이 일들의 증인이다.
ko.B: 너희는 이 일들의 증인이다.
ko.R: 너희는 이 모든 일을 직접 본 증인이다. 그러니 이 일을 사람들에게 알려야 한다.

pt.L: Vocês são testemunhas destas coisas.
pt.B: Vocês são testemunhas de tudo isso.
pt.R: Vocês viram todas essas coisas e devem contá-las aos outros.

am.L: እናንተ የዚህ ምስክሮች ናችሁ።
am.B: እናንተ የዚህ ነገር ምስክሮች ናችሁ።
am.R: ይህን ሁሉ አይታችኋል፤ ለሌሎችም ልትነግሩ ይገባችኋል።

decisions.choice: witnesses: those who saw and will tell
decisions.reason: A witness is one who has seen something and speaks about it. In Acts the apostles are witnesses of the risen Jesus (Acts 1:8, 22; 2:32). The later sense, one who dies for the faith, grew out of this word.

decisions.choice: you: emphatic
decisions.reason: The pronoun is stated and stands first: the people in that room are the ones who will carry the message.

decisions.choice: You have seen all these things, and you are to tell others about them.
alternatives: You are witnesses of these things.
decisions.reason: Readable explains both parts of being a witness: seeing and telling.

decisions.choice: "직접 본 증인 ... 알려야 한다" (R)
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the style guide's "증인" and says what a witness does, as the English Readable explains it.

source.text: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐξαποστέλλω τὴν ἐπαγγελίαν τοῦ πατρός μου ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς· ὑμεῖς δὲ καθίσατε ἐν τῇ πόλει ἕως οὗ ἐνδύσησθε ἐξ ὕψους δύναμιν.

records.literal_gloss: And behold I am sending the promise of the Father of me upon you; you however stay in the city until you are clothed from on high [with] power.

en.L: And look, I am sending the promise of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Father upon you; but you, stay in the city until you are clothed with power from on high."
en.B: I am sending upon you what {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Father promised. As for you, remain here in the city until power from on high clothes you."
en.R: I am going to send you the Holy Spirit, whom {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Father promised. But stay here in the city until you receive power from heaven."

es.L: Y {{plural_you:miren|mirad}}, yo envío la promesa de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Padre sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}; pero {{plural_you:ustedes, quédense|vosotros, quedaos}} en la ciudad hasta que {{plural_you:sean|seáis}} vestidos de poder de lo alto».
es.B: Yo envío sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} lo que {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Padre prometió. En cuanto a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, {{plural_you:quédense|quedaos}} aquí en la ciudad hasta que el poder de lo alto {{plural_you:los|os}} revista».
es.R: Yo {{plural_you:les|os}} voy a enviar el Espíritu Santo, a quien {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Padre prometió. Pero {{plural_you:quédense|quedaos}} aquí en la ciudad hasta que {{plural_you:reciban|recibáis}} poder del cielo».

fr.L: Et voici, moi, j’envoie sur vous la promesse de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Père ; mais vous, restez dans la ville jusqu’à ce que vous soyez revêtus de puissance d’en haut. »
fr.B: J’envoie sur vous ce que {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Père a promis. Quant à vous, restez ici dans la ville jusqu’à ce que la puissance d’en haut vous revête. »
fr.R: Je vais vous envoyer l’Esprit Saint, que {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Père a promis. Mais restez ici, dans la ville, jusqu’à ce que vous receviez la puissance qui vient du ciel. »

sw.L: Na tazameni, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ninaituma ahadi ya Baba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} juu yenu; lakini ninyi bakini mjini mpaka mtakapovikwa nguvu kutoka juu."
sw.B: Ninawaletea kile ambacho Baba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} aliahidi. Lakini ninyi, bakini hapa mjini mpaka nguvu kutoka juu iwavike."
sw.R: Nitawaletea Roho Mtakatifu, ambaye Baba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} aliahidi. Lakini kaeni hapa mjini mpaka mpokee nguvu kutoka mbinguni."

vi.L: Và kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sai lời hứa của Cha {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} xuống trên các con; còn các con, hãy ở lại trong thành cho đến khi các con được mặc lấy quyền năng từ trên cao."
vi.B: Ta sắp sai đến trên các con điều Cha {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã hứa. Còn các con hãy ở lại trong thành cho đến khi được mặc lấy quyền năng từ trên cao."
vi.R: Ta sẽ sai Đức Thánh Linh đến với các con, là Đấng mà Cha {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã hứa. Nhưng các con hãy ở lại trong thành cho đến khi các con nhận được quyền năng từ trời."

ko.L: 그리고 보라, 내가 내 아버지의 약속을 너희 위에 보낸다. 그러나 너희는 위로부터 능력을 입을 때까지 이 성에 머물러 있어라."
ko.B: 이제 내가 내 아버지께서 약속하신 것을 너희에게 보내겠다. 너희는 위로부터 오는 능력을 입을 때까지 이 성에 머물러 있어라."
ko.R: 나는 내 아버지께서 약속하신 성령을 너희에게 보낼 것이다. 그러니 너희는 하늘에서 오는 능력을 받을 때까지 이 성안에 머물러 있어라."

pt.L: E eis que eu envio sobre vocês a promessa do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Pai; mas vocês, fiquem na cidade até que sejam revestidos de poder do alto."
pt.B: Estou enviando sobre vocês o que o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Pai prometeu. Quanto a vocês, fiquem aqui na cidade até que o poder do alto os revista."
pt.R: Vou enviar a vocês o Espírito Santo, que o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Pai prometeu. Mas fiquem aqui na cidade até receberem o poder que vem do céu."

am.L: እነሆም፣ እኔ የአባቴን ተስፋ በእናንተ ላይ እልካለሁ፤ እናንተ ግን ከላይ ኃይልን እስክትለብሱ ድረስ በከተማዪቱ ተቀመጡ።»
am.B: አባቴ የሰጠውን ተስፋ በእናንተ ላይ እልካለሁ። እናንተ ግን ከላይ በሚመጣ ኃይል እስክትለበሱ ድረስ በዚህ ከተማ ቆዩ።»
am.R: አባቴ ቃል የገባውን መንፈስ ቅዱስን እልክላችኋለሁ። እናንተ ግን ከሰማይ ኃይል እስክትቀበሉ ድረስ በዚህ ከተማ ቆዩ።»

decisions.choice: the promise of my Father: the Holy Spirit
decisions.reason: In Acts Jesus tells the apostles to wait in Jerusalem for what the Father promised, and says they will be baptized with the Holy Spirit (Acts 1:4-5, 8). Peter says Jesus received from the Father the promised Holy Spirit and poured him out (Acts 2:33). John the Baptist had foretold it (3:16).

decisions.choice: I am sending: a present that points to what is about to happen
decisions.reason: The present tense describes something certain and near. The Spirit came at Pentecost (Acts 2:1-4).

decisions.choice: clothed with power: power put on like clothing
decisions.reason: The Hebrew Scriptures say the Spirit of the LORD "clothed" Gideon (Judges 6:34). "From on high" means from God in heaven (1:78; Isaiah 32:15).

decisions.choice: the city: the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: the city of Jerusalem, the reading of many later manuscripts
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts add "of Jerusalem". The earliest lack it. The city is Jerusalem either way (24:47, 52). Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: look (L); not rendered as a separate word, or "now" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Jesus uses this word to draw attention to his promise. "Behold" is old-fashioned; Literal says "look", and Balanced and Readable carry the force in the flow of the sentence, as in Matthew 1:20.

decisions.choice: the Holy Spirit, whom my Father promised
decisions.reason: Readable names the promise, as Acts 1:4-5 and 2:33 do.

decisions.choice: receive power from heaven
alternatives: are clothed with power from on high
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of clothing and the phrase "from on high".

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:miren|mirad}}
decisions.reason: Here "look" is said to the whole group, so it is plural and takes the plural_you setting, as the term sheet sets for the Gospels. Balanced and Readable leave it out, as the English does.

decisions.choice: vestidos de poder (L); el poder ... los revista (B)
decisions.reason: The Greek pictures power put on like clothing (meaning decision m3); "vestir" and "revestir" keep the image, where "investir" would turn it into an appointment to office.

decisions.choice: mtakapovikwa nguvu (L); nguvu ... iwavike (B)
decisions.reason: The Greek pictures power put on like clothing (meaning decision m3); "kuvika" (to clothe) keeps the image. Readable says "receive", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "được mặc lấy quyền năng" (L, B); "nhận được quyền năng" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the picture of power put on like clothing (meaning decision); Readable says it plainly.

decisions.choice: "능력을 입다" (L, B); "능력을 받다" (R)
decisions.reason: Power put on like clothing (meaning decision): Korean "입다" keeps the picture; Readable says it plainly.

source.text: Ἐξήγαγεν δὲ αὐτοὺς ἕως πρὸς Βηθανίαν, καὶ ἐπάρας τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῦ εὐλόγησεν αὐτούς.

records.literal_gloss: He led out then them as far as to Bethany, and having lifted up the hands of him he blessed them.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} led them out as far as toward Bethany, and lifting up {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hands, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} blessed them.
en.B: He led them out until they were near Bethany. There {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} raised {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hands and blessed them.
en.R: Then Jesus led {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} followers out of the city to a place near the village of Bethany. He lifted up {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hands and blessed them.

es.L: Y los condujo fuera, hasta llegar frente a Betania, y levantando {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} manos, los bendijo.
es.B: Los sacó hasta las cercanías de Betania. Allí alzó {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} manos y los bendijo.
es.R: Después Jesús llevó a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos fuera de la ciudad, a un lugar cerca del pueblo de Betania. Levantó {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} manos y los bendijo.

fr.L: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les emmena dehors jusque vers Béthanie, et, levant {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} mains, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les bénit.
fr.B: Il les emmena dehors, jusque près de Béthanie. Là, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leva {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} mains et les bénit.
fr.R: Puis Jésus a emmené {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples hors de la ville, jusqu’à un endroit près du village de Béthanie. Il a levé les mains et les a bénis.

sw.L: Kisha akawapeleka nje hadi kuelekea Bethania, na alipoinua mikono {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, akawabariki.
sw.B: Akawatoa nje mpaka walipokaribia Bethania. Huko akainua mikono {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, akawabariki.
sw.R: Kisha Yesu akawaongoza wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} nje ya mji mpaka mahali karibu na kijiji cha Bethania. Akainua mikono {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, akawabariki.

vi.L: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dẫn họ ra đến gần Bê-tha-ni, và giơ tay lên, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chúc phước cho họ.
vi.B: Ngài dẫn họ ra đến gần làng Bê-tha-ni. Tại đó {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giơ tay lên và chúc phước cho họ.
vi.R: Rồi Đức Giê-xu dẫn các môn đồ ra khỏi thành, đến một nơi gần làng Bê-tha-ni. Ngài giơ tay lên và chúc phước cho họ.

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 그들을 데리고 베다니 가까이까지 나가셔서, 손을 들어 그들을 축복하셨다.
ko.B: 예수께서는 그들을 데리고 베다니 근처까지 나가셨다. 그리고 손을 들어 그들을 축복하셨다.
ko.R: 예수께서는 자기를 따르는 사람들을 데리고 성 밖으로 나가 베다니 마을 근처까지 가셨다. 그리고 두 손을 들어 그들을 축복하셨다.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os levou para fora até as proximidades de Betânia e, levantando as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} mãos, os abençoou.
pt.B: Ele os levou para fora, até perto de Betânia. Ali levantou as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} mãos e os abençoou.
pt.R: Depois Jesus levou os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} seguidores para fora da cidade, até um lugar perto do povoado de Betânia. Ele levantou as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} mãos e os abençoou.

am.L: እስከ ቢታንያም አንጻር ድረስ ወደ ውጭ አወጣቸው፤ እጆቹንም አንሥቶ ባረካቸው።
am.B: ወደ ቢታንያ አቅራቢያ እስኪደርሱ ድረስ ይዞአቸው ወጣ። በዚያም እጆቹን አንሥቶ ባረካቸው።
am.R: ከዚያም ኢየሱስ ደቀ መዛሙርቱን ከከተማ ይዞ ቢታንያ ወደምትባል መንደር አጠገብ ወዳለ ቦታ ወሰዳቸው። እጆቹን አንሥቶ ባረካቸው።

decisions.choice: as far as toward Bethany: to the area near Bethany
decisions.reason: Bethany was a village on the far side of the Mount of Olives, about two miles from Jerusalem (19:29). Acts 1:12 says they returned from the Mount of Olives.

decisions.choice: lifting up his hands, he blessed them: as a priest blesses the people
decisions.reason: Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people and blessed them (Leviticus 9:22). The Gospel began with a priest, Zechariah, who came out of the sanctuary unable to speak to the waiting people (1:21-22); it ends with Jesus blessing his people.

decisions.choice: when this happened: Luke does not mark the time
alternatives: the same day as the resurrection
decisions.reason: Read alone, the Gospel seems to tell the events of 24:36-53 on one day. Luke's second book says Jesus appeared to the apostles over forty days before he was taken up (Acts 1:3).

decisions.choice: his followers out of the city
decisions.reason: Readable says who went and where they went from.

decisions.choice: "các môn đồ" (R)
decisions.reason: The style guide keeps "môn đồ" at every level, Readable included, where the English Readable says "followers".

source.text: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ εὐλογεῖν αὐτὸν αὐτοὺς διέστη ἀπ’ αὐτῶν καὶ ἀνεφέρετο εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν.

records.literal_gloss: And it came to pass in the blessing of him them, he parted from them and was being carried up into the heaven.

en.L: And it happened, while {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was blessing them, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} parted from them and was carried up into heaven.
en.B: He was still blessing them when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} parted from them and was borne up into heaven.
en.R: While {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was blessing them, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} went away from them. God took {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} up into heaven.

es.L: Y sucedió que, mientras {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los bendecía, se separó de ellos y era llevado arriba al cielo.
es.B: Mientras todavía los estaba bendiciendo, se separó de ellos y fue elevado al cielo.
es.R: Mientras los bendecía, se alejó de ellos. Dios {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} llevó arriba, al cielo.

fr.L: Et il arriva, tandis qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les bénissait, qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se sépara d’eux et fut emporté au ciel.
fr.B: Il les bénissait encore quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se sépara d’eux et fut enlevé au ciel.
fr.R: Pendant qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les bénissait, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a quittés. Dieu {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a emporté au ciel.

sw.L: Ikawa, alipokuwa akiwabariki, akajitenga nao, akawa akichukuliwa juu mbinguni.
sw.B: Alipokuwa bado akiwabariki, aliachana nao, akachukuliwa juu mbinguni.
sw.R: Alipokuwa akiwabariki, aliondoka kwao. Mungu akamchukua juu mbinguni.

vi.L: Và xảy ra là, đang khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chúc phước cho họ, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} rời khỏi họ và được đem lên trời.
vi.B: Đang khi còn chúc phước cho họ, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} rời khỏi họ và được cất lên trời.
vi.R: Trong khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang chúc phước cho họ, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} rời khỏi họ. Đức Chúa Trời đem {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lên trời.

ko.L: 그리고 [이런] 일이 있었다. 그분이 그들을 축복하시는 동안에 그들에게서 떠나 하늘로 들려 올라가셨다.
ko.B: 예수께서 그들을 축복하시는 가운데 그들을 떠나 하늘로 들려 올라가셨다.
ko.R: 예수께서는 그들을 축복하시다가 그들을 떠나셨다. 하나님께서 예수를 하늘로 데려가셨다.

pt.L: E aconteceu que, enquanto {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os abençoava, separou-se deles e era levado para o céu.
pt.B: Enquanto ainda os abençoava, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se afastou deles e foi elevado ao céu.
pt.R: Enquanto {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} abençoava os seguidores, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se afastou deles. Deus {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} levou para o céu.

am.L: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ሲባርካቸው ሳለ ከእነርሱ ተለየ፤ ወደ ሰማይም ይወሰድ ነበር።
am.B: ገና እየባረካቸው ሳለ ከእነርሱ ተለየ፤ ወደ ሰማይም ተወሰደ።
am.R: እየባረካቸው ሳለ ከእነርሱ ተለይቶ ሄደ። እግዚአብሔር ወደ ሰማይ ወሰደው።

decisions.choice: and was carried up into heaven: included, as in the SBLGNT
alternatives: the words left out, as in the first hand of Codex Sinaiticus and in Codex Bezae
decisions.reason: Almost all manuscripts, the early papyrus P75 among them, have these words. The first copyist of Codex Sinaiticus and Codex Bezae, with some Old Latin manuscripts, lack them. Luke says in Acts 1:2 that his first book went up to the day Jesus was taken up, which fits the longer text. Codex Bezae and some Old Latin manuscripts, known as Western witnesses, usually have a longer text than other manuscripts, but near the end of Luke they have a shorter text in several places. Where witnesses that tend to add leave something out, the shorter reading may be the original. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: was carried up: God took him up
decisions.reason: The verb is passive: he was taken up. Acts 1:9-11 tells more, with a cloud that took him out of their sight.

decisions.choice: parted from them: went away from them
decisions.reason: The verb means to stand apart or to separate. With the following words it means he left them.

decisions.choice: God took him up
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one who took him, as the passive implies (Acts 1:2, 11).

decisions.choice: "được đem lên" (L), "được cất lên" (B); "Đức Chúa Trời đem ... lên" (R)
decisions.reason: The passive is God's act (meaning decision); "được cất lên trời" as in the Vietnamese Mark 16:19, and Readable names God.

decisions.choice: "들려 올라가다" (L, B); "하나님께서 ... 데려가셨다" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Korean Mark 16:19: the passive means God took him up (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "ተወሰደ" / "ይወሰድ ነበር" (was carried up), a passive
decisions.reason: The Greek verb is passive: he was taken up, by God, as the meaning decision says. "ዐረገ" would make him the one who acts.

source.text: καὶ αὐτοὶ προσκυνήσαντες αὐτὸν ὑπέστρεψαν εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ μετὰ χαρᾶς μεγάλης, καὶ ἦσαν διὰ παντὸς ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ εὐλογοῦντες τὸν θεόν.

records.literal_gloss: And they having worshiped him returned to Jerusalem with joy great, \v 53 and were continually in the temple blessing God.

en.L: And they, having worshiped {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, returned to Jerusalem with great joy, \v 53 and they were continually in the temple, blessing God.
en.B: They bowed down in worship before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, then made their way back to Jerusalem with great joy. \v 53 And they spent all their time in the temple, blessing God.
en.R: Then they worshiped {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. They went back to Jerusalem, filled with joy. \v 53 They were always at the temple, giving thanks and praise to God.

es.L: Y ellos, habiéndolo adorado, regresaron a Jerusalén con gran gozo, \v 53 y estaban continuamente en el templo, bendiciendo a Dios.
es.B: Ellos se postraron en adoración ante {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, y luego regresaron a Jerusalén con gran gozo. \v 53 Y pasaban todo el tiempo en el templo, bendiciendo a Dios.
es.R: Entonces {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} adoraron. Volvieron a Jerusalén llenos de alegría. \v 53 Siempre estaban en el templo, dando gracias y alabanzas a Dios.

fr.L: Et eux, {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}ayant adoré, retournèrent à Jérusalem avec une grande joie, \v 53 et ils étaient continuellement dans le temple, bénissant Dieu.
